text:
Zoe K.: FYI I opened a PR to add q4/q8 model-cards for aurora-13b and a short migration + compatibility section: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5328 :wave:
Ethan M.: sweet. for the perf table please include instance+precision (a100-80gb fp16, a100-40gb q8) and the raw CSV link so teams can reproduce.
Zoe K.: added an "instance / precision" column and linked CSV. also added a one-line limits box: max seq 8192 (fp16), 4096 (q8), recommended batch <= 12 for q8.
Priya S.: heads-up CI will fail if snippets still use `client.generate()`. I'll swap to `client.text.generate()` and add SNIPPET markers.
Zoe K.: thanks, please also add a short migration checklist for infra teams migrating rollout policies that reference unpinned model names.
Ethan M.: suggestion for rollout note: "If you use rollouts or canary policies, pin the model variant in the route config to avoid silent behavior changes during model updates."
Priya S.: added the checklist and a tiny example of a route config change.
```
# old route (unpinned)
route:
  model: aurora-13b-q8
  traffic: 100%

# new (pinned variant)
route:
  model: aurora-13b@q8-2026-09-01
  traffic: 100%
```

Priya S.: also added SDK snippets for Python/Node and a short CLI example. markers: `SNIPPET_START:sdk-py-aurora-q` / `SNIPPET_START:sdk-node-aurora-q` / `SNIPPET_START:cli-aurora-q`.
bench-bot: bench uploaded: aurora-13b-q8 - a100-40gb - median p95: 48ms (b1), 95ms (b8), 140ms (b12). CSV: s3://bench-uploads/5328/aurora13b_q8.csv
Ethan M.: use median p95 and list instance in table. add a short note that batch>12 shows high variance.
Zoe K.: added a compatibility table row: "Quantized variants (q4/q8): streaming: limited for long contexts; function-calls: best-effort; embeddings: not supported on q4." Kept conservative.
Priya S.: docs-bot flagged a broken link from model-catalog/aurora-13b -> 404 (branch: zoe/aurora-quantized).
docs-bot: linkcheck error: /model-catalog/aurora-13b -> 404 (branch: zoe/aurora-quantized).
Zoe K.: I renamed the card file during the restructure, forgot to update the index. fixing now.
ci-bot: docs build failed - missing snippet marker `SNIPPET_START:sdk-py-aurora-q` in model-card/aurora-13b.md.
Priya S.: pushing the missing marker and corrected Python/Node snippets. Python uses `client.text.generate(...)` and Node uses `client.text.generate(...)`. kept examples minimal.
bench-bot: uploaded updated CSV after re-run with final flags: s3://bench-uploads/5328/aurora13b_q8_v2.csv (numbers unchanged).
Ethan M.: small phrasing tweak for compatibility row: suggest "Pin model variant to lock behavior across releases." pushed wording.
Zoe K.: preview deployed: https://deploy-preview--docs.redwood.ai/model-catalog/aurora-13b (branch: zoe/aurora-quantized)
docs-bot: preview shows one absolute link to /sdk/migration -> should be relative.
Zoe K.: fixing link to ../sdk/migration and re-pushing.
ci-bot: build passed (job #2836) on branch zoe/aurora-quantized.
Ethan M.: product asked to add a one-liner in the Dedicated docs about quantized variants being "best-effort" for certain features. I'll add the backport after merge.
Zoe K.: attaching CSV and final perf table, merging now. Thanks for quick help everyone.
Priya S.: merged and backported snippet markers to stable branch. Closing thread. :tada:
